territories.title: SYNTHETIC: shape packing with controllable deformation
territories.gameable_action: Drag soft-looking objects into a bounded box.
territories.emotion: Satisfaction when an awkward shape finally fits.
territories.player_choice: Choose whether to save height or width when an object deforms.
territories.saturation_risk: unknown: no real market comparison has been performed
territories.counterhypothesis: Viewers may enjoy a transformation video but dislike making spatial decisions.
territories.cheapest_test: One greybox screen with two object shapes and an explicit loss condition.
rights_risks: Use original shapes and audio; do not reuse the fictional source's assets.
evidence_gaps: No live source or player study: this is a fixture, not a ranked idea.

territories.title: SYNTHETIC: gate-routing timing puzzle
territories.gameable_action: Rotate a gate to direct rolling objects.
territories.player_choice: Trade a safe route for a risky sequence that frees more space.
territories.saturation_risk: unknown: paid ad format alone does not describe the market
territories.counterhypothesis: The clip may overstate controllability and omit awkward timing.
territories.cheapest_test: Test real input latency and player choices in a ten-second simulation.
evidence_gaps: Paid traffic only; no evidence of organic sharing or player return.

territories.title: SYNTHETIC: clearing bubbles to make room
territories.gameable_action: Choose a bubble to pop before space runs out.
territories.emotion: Relief after creating room just in time.
territories.player_choice: Remove an easy target now or reserve a future chain reaction.
